summary: Updated implementation plan for AetherOrbit to add Adaptive Battery-Saver & Power Management (lifecycle-gated sensors, cached trajectory math, Eco/Balanced/Performance modes, single-shot GPS) and Hardened Security Architecture (Android Keystore AES-256-GCM encryption at rest, TLE SHA-256/Modulo-10 integrity verification, disabled ADB backups, and FLAG_SECURE window protection).
